sources.title: Social Sciences Grade 6 Teacher's Guide
sources.notes: Christian curriculum used in private schools. Covers Mapungubwe as part of South African medieval history. Providential framing positions African kingdoms as spiritually incomplete pending European missionary contact.

sources.title: Історія України
sources.author: Щупак І.Я.
sources.notes: Post-2022 New Ukrainian School (NUS) reform edition. Explicit Hrushevsky citation arguing Ukrainian succession to Kievan Rus.

sources.title: История России, IX — начало XVI в.
sources.author: Мединский В.Р., Торкунов А.В.
sources.notes: State-mandated textbook authored by Vladimir Medinsky, former Minister of Culture. Approved by Ministry of Education order No.769, November 2024. Covers IX–early XVI century.

sources.title: Our Pasts – II
sources.author: NCERT
sources.notes: National Council of Educational Research and Training. Chapter 3: The Delhi Sultans. Standard curriculum across all Indian states.
